author: THSV StreamBridge
description: Posts separate guarded Twitch, YouTube, Kick, and optional TikTok live embeds to a Discord channel or forum.
changelog: 3.0.0: aligned with THSV StreamBridge 3.0.0, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.6.1: aligned with THSV StreamBridge 2.6.1, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.6.0: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.6.0 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.5.2: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.5.2 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.5.1: adds separate platform embeds, direct live links, and a creator-controlled OBS, Meld, or Streamlabs Desktop start fallback for TikTok. 2.5.0: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.5.0 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.4.3: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.4.3 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.4.2: initial release with stable stream identity, multi-platform coalescing, channel/forum destinations, role mention validation, source-derived links, simulation suppression, and bounded persistent deduplication.

manifest.name: Live Beacon

actionsProvided.name: THSV Addon - Live Beacon - Broadcast Started

installationSteps: Import the Live Beacon Streamer.bot package.
Set the one shared private Discord webhook in Deliver. Advanced creators may manually add a platform-specific webhook argument only when a platform uses a different parent channel or forum.
Choose Create for me or Use existing posts. Create for me makes and remembers each permanent post on its first genuine live event; existing mode uses copied Discord Channel IDs.
Leave Deliver triggerless. Attach OBS, Meld, or Streamlabs Desktop Streaming Started to Broadcast Started only when selected platforms need a broadcast-app fallback.
Approve only its triggerless Deliver action, configure platform links/templates, then enable the add-on.
uninstallationSteps: Uninstall the add-on. Its bounded stream deduplication history remains preserved.

healthChecks.description: Confirms verified online events can produce guarded per-platform Discord deliveries.
